scope: 11 actual training runs on this device, their saved best/final weights, four historical inference artifacts, and 21 train-only BN recalibration variants
checkpoint_format: model_state_dict plus original configuration, provenance and selection metadata, loadable with weights_only=True
training_state: Original optimizer, scheduler, RNG and full history remain in the local runs directory
state_sha256_convention: Sorted tensor names, each followed by a JSON [name, torch dtype, shape] header and LF, then contiguous CPU NumPy C-order bytes
